srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you take the Attack action with a Quarterstaff, Spear, Glaive, or Halberd, you can make a Bonus Action butt attack (1d4 bludgeoning). Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks when they enter your reach with those weapons.
